nom: DERMA E Vitamin C Bright Eyes Hydro Gel Patches

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe their skin or eyes as sensitive say the patches are gentle, fragrance-free, and dermatologist-recommended enough to use without irritation, even those who normally react to eye products or moisturizers, though a couple of reviewers report the patches themselves caused burning, irritation, or dryness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry under-eye skin, including one recovering from a hospital stay and one who struggles with dry, lined under-eyes before makeup, report the patches hydrate and smooth the area without irritation, though one reviewer says the patches dried her under-eyes out and caused irritation.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly firmer, tighter, smoother under-eye skin after use, including less crepey, crinkly texture and reduced fine lines with regular use over weeks; a number of others, however, say they used them consistently and saw no visible difference at all.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the gel patches hydrate, soften, and moisturize the under-eye area, including relief for skin that felt dry and tight beforehand; several others report the patches themselves dry out quickly or don't carry enough serum to leave the skin moisturized, and one says the patches dried her under-eyes out and irritated them.
concerns.redness: One reviewer prone to reddish, easily irritated skin reports no irritation and good tolerance, and another notes the patches don't burn the way some others have; against that, a couple of reviewers experienced an instant burning sensation or noticeable irritation after applying them.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report a visible reduction in under-eye dark circles and discoloration with continued use, some noticing a difference after just one application and others after weeks; a few, including one with genetic dark circles, say the darkness only lightened partially or that they saw no brightening effect at all.

aspects.libelle: Patches tear easily when removed from jar
Can slide or slip out of place
Leftover residue can pill under makeup
Rounded shape doesn't fit every eye

extraits.texte: I really wanted to like these but after using it a few times I noticed alot of irritation and not alot of benefits and my skin can take alot but couldn't handle these vitamin c patches really dried under eyes out too

I wanted to love this product, but I couldn't tolerate the instant burning sensation (less than 5 mins wear). I've used other vitamin c serums with no reactions. Anyway, like others stated the patches did tear easily. Returning.

I am so excited I got the Vitamin C Bright Eyes Hydrogel Patches in return for my honest, unbiased feedback. I recently got discharged from the hospital a couple of days after kidney donor transplant. Being in the hospital for days made my skin dry and tight. I am so happy I arrived home to this Beautiful yellow packaging combo of Vitamin C! After I washed my face and dried, I used Vitamin C Bright Eyes Hydrogel Patches, only applied for 4-5 mins and saw brightening results. I am usually afraid of using products since they usually irritate my skin the right way and my face has reddish spots. with DERMAE Vitamin C Bright Eyes Hydrogel Patches there was no irritation and it's because of its sulfate-free, Vegan and clean ingredients. its 100% vegan, cruelty-free formula and NON-GMO. Very easy to use and has a coinvent mini spatula to separate the pieces before application. I use it in the morning for the best results. The only down side for me was the shape of eye patches seemed very rounded and didn't fit correctly for my eye shape.

I've never used a product that has worked as fast and as well as these eye hydrogels do. These brighten, soothe, depuff, and hydrate my underyes all at the same time. I put them on in the morning, make my coffee and breakfast, and maybe do a few chores (I took down curtains yesterday morning while wearing them and they stayed on fine). I also have very sensitive eyes and cant use a lot of moisturizer and eye creams but these dont bother me at all.

Not only are they dermatologist recommended and 100% vegan, but they are also easy to use and I really see a difference when I use them consistently. They are now a staple in my skincare routine!
